detail: Findmypast, searched while signed in on 16 October 2026: Hertfordshire Baptisms (surname-only, county-wide), Hertfordshire Burials, and the 1841 and 1851 censuses at Aldenham. The surname-only passes that the 13 October session could not repeat are now done.

236 entries (some twice) across 22 places, Tring, Aldbury and Bovingdon the largest. The Marys among them were baptised in 1723 and 1737, then not again until 1857 (Mary Elizabeth) and 1864 (Mary Ann). NO MARY WAS BAPTISED BURCH IN THE COUNTY BETWEEN 1738 AND 1856. The name-variants option did not bring in Birch. Aldenham holds 7 Burch baptisms, none before 1811.

Berkhamsted 1765 (Daniel and Mary); Abbots Langley 1773 (William); Northchurch 1781 (Jonathan and Agnes); Abbots Langley 1782 (Adam); Wigginton 1783 (Jno); Watford, born 27 December 1782 (Chas and Mary); St Albans Abbey 1783 (Mary Ann; Thomas and Elizabeth); Abbots Langley, born 26 August 1784 (John); Bovingdon, born 26 August 1791 (James and Rebecca). None is chosen.

24 entries: Aldenham, John and Hannah 1740 to 1749; Aldenham, William and Ann 1809 to 1828; Aldenham, William and Sarah 1848 to 1864; Rickmansworth 1856; Watford 1871; North Mimms 1893. NO MARY BEFORE 1851 AT ALL.
The set stops about 1810: the last Hawkins burial at Aldenham in it is 1808 and the last Larkin is 1810, though the baptism set runs past 1860. A burial missing from it after 1810 is not a finding.

MARY LARKIN, head, WIDOW, 51, straw hat maker, BORN EDGWARE, MIDDLESEX; ROBERT LARKIN, son, 30, agricultural labourer, born Aldenham; ELIZA LARKIN, daughter, 20, straw hat maker, born Aldenham. In the 1841 index the same Mary (recorded as 40, born 1800) is followed by Robert 20, Joseph 12, Eliza 10 and Thomas 8.

record: The register's children of 'Robert and Mary Larkin'
detail: Aldenham baptisms, father a labourer in every one. Sarah, born 30 March 1814 (banns were called on 16 January 1814); Mary, born 8 September 1815; Elizabeth, 1818; Joseph, born 4 May 1820; Robert William, born 4 June 1821; EMMA, BORN 3 MARCH 1822; Amy 1823; James, born 29 April 1824; John and a second Joseph, both baptised 23 November 1828; Thomas, baptised 31 March 1833.

EMMA WAS BORN 272 DAYS AFTER ROBERT WILLIAM. They cannot share a mother. Robert William is the Robert aged 30 in the household of the widow Mary born at Edgware about 1800, who would have been 21 at his birth, and Joseph (second), Eliza and Thomas fit the same household. The other couple is the pair of 1851 household one, born at Aldenham about 1779 and 1782, whose daughters Mary and Elizabeth match the baptisms of 1815 and 1818 in name and, within about three years, in age. That couple is the banns couple of 1814, and the only Robert-and-Mary marriage in the Aldenham register. The earlier note on this site that the eleven children were one family, 'two Josephs, so the first had died', is withdrawn.

1851: 23 Hawkinses; none is a Mary born before 1790. 1841: 20 Hawkinses; the only William old enough to have married in 1800 is William, 65, at Round Bush (HO107 piece 438 book 3 folio 10 page 14, schedule 477), in a household of Mash and Rogers, with no wife. NO MARY HAWKINS OF HER AGE IS INDEXED AT ALDENHAM IN EITHER CENSUS. That does not say when Mary Appleyard died.
